name: MINER
full_name: Mitchell Institute Neutrino Experiment at Reactor
summary: MINER develops low-threshold cryogenic detectors near the Texas A&M TRIGA reactor to search for coherent reactor-neutrino scattering. The programme also uses the same apparatus to test reactor-produced particles beyond the Standard Model.
detection_principle: Cryogenic crystals convert recoil energy into small phonon signals. Low-noise thermal sensors, shielding and reactor-on/off comparisons probe nuclear recoils below the energy scale accessible to conventional scintillator detectors.
